verdict.rationale: HelixDB documents a multi-tenancy page describing three isolation-level models and explicitly states Helix Cloud only provides row-level isolation, leaving tenant separation to be implemented at the application layer rather than via native namespaces or per-tenant collections; the CLI does allow creating multiple databases per project (a coarse per-tenant-database pattern) and rate-limit overrides are documented, but there's no dedicated low-cost namespace/partition primitive or per-tenant scaling limits documented. Missing for 10: a native namespace/partition/collection isolation primitive, documented per-tenant resource limits and cost model, and independent evidence of cheap scaling to many tenants.
